### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, touching **4** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via os db orphans (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/db/orphans.ts), os secret orphans (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/secret/orphans.ts))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via os secret orphans (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/secret/orphans.ts))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-1.mdx`  _(via os db orphans (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/db/orphans.ts))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **40** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3aa008d436c593b30be1d3c2d444273e68458b99` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `d1283f03a98ede03433adf89b5c9cc36ab3cbcd4` — the merge of head `ca5b49ee6dacd0298534cc5191d411c8fe7caa43` into base `3aa008d436c593b30be1d3c2d444273e68458b99`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin d1283f03a98ede03433adf89b5c9cc36ab3cbcd4 && git checkout d1283f03a98ede03433adf89b5c9cc36ab3cbcd4
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 3aa008d436c593b30be1d3c2d444273e68458b99 ca5b49ee6dacd0298534cc5191d411c8fe7caa43 && git checkout -B drift-repro 3aa008d436c593b30be1d3c2d444273e68458b99 && git merge --no-ff ca5b49ee6dacd0298534cc5191d411c8fe7caa43

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3aa008d436c593b30be1d3c2d444273e68458b99
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 3aa008d436c593b30be1d3c2d444273e68458b99` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

Verdict: **REWORK** · head `4cb78e091b2293ff951a80618cf36b5120ef305a` · card #36331

Reviewed against GitHub at this head (diff, card body, `l1-face.mjs --pr 36676` exit 0, `pr-state.mjs`), not against the report.

### Checklist
- Shape: open, draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #36331`; no closing keyword binds another card. `Fixes` is right: the three Done-when lines are delivered (text face non-TTY exit 1 naming `--yes` in both commands, the interactive decline kept at exit 0 as the migrate family does, a sibling pin over both commands with an ablation: 2 red at `origin/main` sources, restored to the HEAD blobs).
- Scope: 4 files, all inside the card (2 command sources, 1 new pin, 1 changeset); no release path.
- Changeset sentences read against the diff: the new line text, the exit 1, the `n` decline staying `Aborted — …` exit 0, and the `--json` face unchanged all hold in both `db/orphans.ts` and `secret/orphans.ts`. The level `patch` with `Metadata-protocol: none` is right under the `none` kind.
- Pin: the roster case reads the command classes' flags (`delete` + `yes`) so a third such command fails until it has a row; `process.stdin.isTTY` is set per run; deletes and export writes are observed on fakes.
- Gates at this head: Lint & Repo Gates `success`, TypeScript Type Check `success`; all checks 37 success, 16 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending.

### REWORK items
1. **The narrowing is undeclared.** The text face's exit status goes from `0` to `1` for the same invocation. The card's own named precedent, `os migrate apply` (`62bc129` in `packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md`), made exactly this change and declared it as `fix(cli)!`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, an `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker, and a **BREAKING** (an exit status narrows) banner with FROM / TO / Unchanged / the fix for a script. This PR carries a bare `Clause-②: no`, no `!`, no banner and no marker. Fix in the changeset body and the PR body/title, following that precedent: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `!` in the title and changeset headline, the BREAKING banner (FROM: `--delete` without `--yes`, stdin not a terminal, text face: nothing deleted, exit `0`; TO: same, exit `1`, the new `Confirmation required…` line; Unchanged: `n` at the prompt exits `0`, `--json` already exited `1`; the fix for a script: pass `--yes`), and the `adr-0087` marker. Run `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` again after the edit. No code change is asked.
2. **Owed once the arm is declared:** the dogfood battery in full, pinned to the new head (`dogfood_battery` in the report), and a contract review on the narrowing face at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, which this review thread runs on the new head.

Reach read from source only. Left to the seat's filing gate, as one family-close card that also widens the pin population to apply-behind-`--yes` modes outside `migrate`.
